title: Mastech Digital to Discuss Third Quarter Financial Results on November 12, 2025

## Mastech Digital to Discuss Third Quarter Financial Results on November 12, 2025


November 3, 2025


[PDF Version](https://investors.mastechdigital.com/node/11266/pdf)


PITTSBURGH


, Nov. 3, 2025


/PRNewswire/ -- Mastech Digital, Inc. (NYSE American: MHH) ("Mastech Digital"), a leading provider of Digital Transformation IT Services, today announced the date for the release of its third quarter 2025 financial results.


Mr. Nirav Patel, CEO, and Mr. Kannan Sugantharaman, CFO, will host a conference call on Wednesday, November 12, 2025, at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time to discuss its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2025. Financial results will be issued in a press release prior to the call.


Those wishing to participate via webcast should access the call through the Investors section of Mastech Digital's website at[http://www.mastechdigital.com](http://www.mastechdigital.com/) . Those wishing to participate via telephone may dial in at 1-877-269-7756 (domestic) or 1-201-689-7817 (international). The replay will be available via webcast through Mastech Digital's website.


**About** **Mastech** **Digital,** **Inc.**


Mastech Digital (NYSE American: MHH) is a leading provider of Digital Transformation IT Services. The Company offers Data Management and Analytics Solutions, Digital Learning, and IT Staffing Services with a digital-first approach. A minority-owned enterprise, Mastech Digital is headquartered in Pittsburgh, PA, with offices across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and India.
